mentions.name: Recruiter anti-bot application screening tool
mentions.description: This tool helps recruiters and hiring teams combat AI-generated resume spam by introducing a small amount of friction that filters out bots while minimally impacting legitimate applicants. The first iteration is ready, with infrastructure being finalized ahead of a planned Show HN launch.
mentions.problem: AI resume spam has overwhelmed hiring: job listings receive thousands of customized junk resumes within an hour, and qualified candidates get drowned out.
mentions.audience: Recruiters and hiring teams struggling with floods of AI-generated resume spam.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a tool for the recruiters and hiring teams to combat this and bring some sanity back to the already challenging process. The general idea is to introduce a small bit of friction that will hopefully be not-too-impacting for legit applicants while stopping bots from proceeding.

evidence.value: I'm building a tool for the recruiters and hiring teams to combat this and bring some sanity back to the already challenging process.
